title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen computation by reusing shared layers, approaching larger models' capabilities with fewer parameters and easing the storage and deployment burden of stacking independent layers. However, repeatedly processing long visual sequences still incurs substantial compute and GPU memory costs. Visual token compression reduces these costs by shortening sequences. Existing methods mainly select original tokens directly or combine selection with aggregation. In looped models, the former may overlook changing token importance across calls and discard information needed later; the latter lack joint consideration of output changes across calls, limiting information preservation. We propose LoopZip, a training-free visual token compression algorithm addressing both issues. translated_title: LoopZip：面向高效循环视觉语言模型的视觉标记压缩
translated_abstract: 循环视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过重用共享层来加深计算，以更少的参数逼近更大模型的能力，并减轻堆叠独立层带来的存储和部署负担。然而，反复处理长视觉序列仍会产生大量的计算和GPU显存开销。视觉标记压缩通过缩短序列来降低这些开销。现有方法主要是直接选择原始标记，或将选择与聚合相结合。在循环模型中，前者可能忽视各次调用间标记重要性的变化，从而丢弃后续所需的信息；后者则缺乏对各次调用间输出变化的联合考虑，限制了信息的保留。我们提出LoopZip，一种无需训练的视觉标记压缩算法，同时解决上述两个问题。视觉聚合在循环主干之前构建一个紧凑的候选池，跨调用选择则对各次调用的指令注意力进行平均（摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）。
tldr: LoopZip是一种无需训练的视觉标记压缩算法，通过在循环主干前构建紧凑候选池并结合跨调用选择，降低循环视觉语言模型处理长视觉序列时的计算与GPU显存开销。
en_tdlr: LoopZip is a training-free visual token compression algorithm that reduces compute and GPU memory costs in looped vision-language models by building a compact candidate pool before the looped backbone and performing cross-invocation selection.
